Description: RC2014 enhanced bus connector, pin header 2 x 40, 2.54 mm, angled
Dual 12-bit D/A converter with SPI (Microchip MCP4822)
Microcontroller ATmega8 (firmware not yet in this repository)
8-bit comparator: card address against the DIP switch
Resistor network 8 x 10 kOhm, common pin, SIL9
Box header 6 pins (2 x 3), 2.54 mm: ISP connector of the ATmega8
Pluggable terminal block 6 pins, 3.5 mm: analog outputs with +5 V and GND
Pin header 2 x 8, 2.54 mm, with jumper: selects the interrupt line /INT0-/INT7 of the XIO PIC
